Delicious Tapas!
Jul 2025 • Solo
OCTO TAPAS RESTOBAR - @octotapas 

OCTO elevates traditional Spanish tapas with exacting technique and premium ingredients, earning its place in the Michelin Guide. The intimate, minimalist setting—dark wood, soft lighting, an open kitchen—keeps focus on the food, where execution matters more than flair. 

The kitchen demonstrates a confident grasp of Spanish fundamentals. Their Joselito Jamon Iberico de Bellota (unfortunately not hand cut) is served at perfect temperature. Other dishes show similar discipline: textures are precise, flavors layered but never muddled, and sauces reduced to concentrated essences. Even simple elements—like olive oil or bread—are sourced with discernment. 

Wine pairings are thoughtful, favoring Spanish producers, while service remains sharp yet unobtrusive. This is a restaurant for purists—no gimmicks, just meticulous tapas crafted for those who appreciate restraint over excess. A standout in Saigon’s dining scene, OCTO delivers substance without spectacle.
